html:
The student-run website of the Computer Science and Engineering Department at GEC Sreekrishnapuram — a one-stop destination for academic programs, events, and student resources. Forked from CSEGECPKD/cse_dept_site.

✨ Key features

  • Department overview — mission, vision, and objectives
  • Academic programs with syllabus, curriculum, and admission details
  • Research and projects highlights
  • Events & news updates
  • Resources for students (course materials, schedules, timetables)
  • Achievements, recognitions, and a vibrant gallery

Built with Next.js and styled with Tailwind CSS, deployed at cse-site-one.vercel.app.
